title: 1Password Lets AI Agents Log In Without Revealing Passwords
excerpt: A new feature from 1Password enables AI agents to access personal accounts for users while keeping private credentials secure.
body_html:
1Password has introduced a new feature designed to allow artificial intelligence agents to log into personal accounts on behalf of users without exposing the underlying private credentials.

As AI agents become more integrated into daily digital tasks, security remains a primary concern for users granting automated systems access to personal services. This capability aims to bridge that gap by letting automated helpers perform logins while the sensitive data that secures those accounts stays protected.

By preventing the AI agent from directly viewing the actual password, the system maintains a layer of defense for user accounts during automated interactions.
